# Ridetech Content Brief

## Company Overview
Ridetech (site: ridetech.com) is a performance suspension specialist based in Jasper, Indiana. It makes suspension systems that improve handling and ride quality for muscle cars, trucks, Corvettes and hot rods. Its customers range from restorers and show-car builders to autocross and track-day drivers. Its premium range includes air suspension (air ride), coil-overs, shock absorbers, coil and leaf springs, tubular control arms, roll bars, sway bars and more. Visitors who can't find what they want are invited to get in touch.

![](images/para.jpg)

## Contact Details
- Phone: 812.481.4787 (also linked as tel:812.481.4787 and tel:812-481-4787)
- Fax: 812.634.6632
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 6:00pm EST
- Address: 350 S. St. Charles St, Jasper, Indiana, 47546
- Email: sales@ridetech.com
- Social and contact links: Facebook (http://www.facebook.com/ridetech), Instagram (http://instagram.com/ridetechsuspension), email (mailto:sales@ridetech.com), phone, YouTube (http://www.youtube.com/ridetechtv/)

![](images/grade.jpg)

## Shipping Offer
Orders of $100 or more get free ground shipping within the continental U.S.

## Free Catalog
Ridetech offers a free product catalog. A call to action reads "Request a Catalog", and a "Get a FREE Catalog" link is also offered. Both go to https://www.ridetech.com/information/free-catalog/.

![](images/catalog-cover-for-flipbook.png)

## Newsletter and Sign-Up
- A "Sign Up for News!" prompt leads to a newsletter form headed "Get Connected".
- The form asks for first name, last name and email address.
- A linked item points to the 1,000,001 Mile Warranty page: https://www.ridetech.com/tech/1000001-mile-warranty/

## Featured Promotions
Four featured items, each linking to its own page:
- 2007–2013 GM Silverado products: https://www.ridetech.com/product-category/applications/trucks/2007_2013_gm_silverado/
  ![](images/silverado-copy.jpg)

  ![](images/ridepro-e5.jpg)

  ![](images/falcon.jpg)
- Camaro/Firebird subframe connectors: https://www.ridetech.com/product/camaro-firebird-subframe-connectors/
  ![](images/camaro-subframe-connector-page.jpg)

## Shop by Vehicle
Five vehicle categories, under https://www.ridetech.com/product-category/applications/:
- Muscle Cars and Classics (musclecars_classics/) ![](images/muscle-car.png)
- Late Model Muscle Cars (late-model-musclecars/) ![](images/modern-muscle.png)
- Trucks (trucks/) ![](images/truck.png)
- Street Rods and Customs (streetrods_customs/) ![](images/hot-rod.png)
- Corvettes (corvettes/) ![](images/corvette.png)

Load Leveling is a further application category (https://www.ridetech.com/product-category/applications/load_leveling/).

## Shop by Product
All under https://www.ridetech.com/product-category/products/ unless noted:
- Suspension Packages (suspension_packages/) ![](images/categories-Camaro-coil-over-systemt-r2ik-jd.jpg)

- Air Ride Suspension Control Systems (air_suspension/air-ride-suspension-control-systems/) ![](images/ridepro-e5-cat-scaled.jpg)

- ShockWave Integrated Air Springs and Shocks (air_suspension/shockwaves/) ![](images/categories-SKWs-scaled.jpg)
- Shock Absorbers (shocks/) ![](images/categories-q-series.jpg)
- R-Joint Rod Ends (r_joint/) ![](images/products-R-Joint-n8gx-pn.jpg)

detail: building website from brief.md and images/ content

content.text:
I've built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in your project folder. It uses the images in `images/` by relative path. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

The page has these sections, in order:
- **Top bar and header:** The top bar shows the shipping offer, phone, hours and email. The sticky header has the logo, navigation, search box, cart ($0.00) and login link.
- **Hero:** It uses `para.jpg` as the background, with "Shop by Vehicle" and "Request a Catalog" buttons. A red free-shipping banner sits below it.
- **Featured:** Four promo cards: Silverado, RidePRO-E5, Ford Falcon article and Camaro subframe connectors.
- **Shop by Vehicle:** Five category cards, plus a Load Leveling link.
- **Shop by Product:** Eleven image cards, plus link chips for the other categories that have no images.
- **Catalog and news:** A free-catalog section with the cover image, and the two news items with links to the news pages.
- **Technical resources and community:** Tech, support, community and account links.
- **Newsletter sign-up:** The "Get Connected" form with a link to the warranty page.
- **Contact and footer:** Address, phone, fax, email, hours, social links, and the policy links with the copyright line.

The page adapts to phone widths and follows light or dark mode.

**Not connected:** The search box and newsletter form do nothing. The form only shows a placeholder message, and neither is wired to a real service.

All other links point to the live ridetech.com URLs from the brief. The page goes beyond the brief in a few places: the hero headline, the short card captions, and the "Get Connected" blurb are my own wording.
